commands.label: Bootstrap Suite
commands.summary: Seeds the canonical scene, asset, preview, tensor, and publish session state.

commands.label: Switch Workspace
commands.summary: Moves the operator into a different DCC lane and marks downstream surfaces for refresh.

commands.label: Ingest Package
commands.summary: Stages a new asset package into the suite ingest lane and updates runtime pack bookkeeping.

commands.label: Activate Tool
commands.summary: Changes the active authoring tool and updates tool preset context.

commands.label: Set Selection
commands.summary: Replaces the live entity selection and updates lane inspectors.

commands.label: Set Gizmo Mode
commands.summary: Switches the active universal gizmo mode for the current authoring selection.

commands.label: Set Gizmo Space
commands.summary: Switches the universal gizmo between world and local evaluation space.

commands.label: Toggle Gizmo Snap
commands.summary: Toggles transform snapping for the active universal gizmo profile.

commands.label: Apply Sculpt Stroke
commands.summary: Queues a sculpt stroke through the native mutation seam and marks downstream lanes dirty.

commands.label: Rebuild Topology
commands.summary: Refreshes topology and graph health analysis against current scene resources.

commands.label: Sync Rig Controls
commands.summary: Synchronizes rig projections and deformation reports.

commands.label: Tick Simulation
commands.summary: Requests the next simulation planning tick and marks cache products dirty.

commands.label: Bake Material Preview
commands.summary: Refreshes the authored PBR preview, SVG mask stack, and packed texture outputs.

commands.label: Author Texture Set
commands.summary: Updates the active texture set, UDIM coverage, and channel preset for the current material.

commands.label: Paint Material Layer
commands.summary: Queues layer-stack changes for fill, paint, filter, and smart-material operators.

commands.label: Edit SVG Mask
commands.summary: Queues SVG mask graph changes, shape edits, booleans, and anchor projections.

commands.label: Export Texture Set
commands.summary: Builds the material export receipt for packed texture delivery into downstream runtimes.

commands.label: Render Preview
commands.summary: Stages a preview render refresh and updates render-facing reports.

commands.label: Rebuild Composite
commands.summary: Refreshes the compositor rebuild plan for the current frame products.

commands.label: Package Publish
commands.summary: Builds the publish summary and package receipts for operator review.

commands.label: Tensor Train Step
commands.summary: Stages a tensor-oriented training plan and readiness report.

commands.label: Tensor Infer Step
commands.summary: Stages a tensor-oriented inference plan and readiness report.
